name: Underwriting
description: Underwriter work items for Builders Risk: reviewing priced quotes, completing policy setup, chasing payment and working the renewal digest. Most tasks here are raised by the underwriting flows.

_notes.statuses: The four states named in Builders.md §3.7.2 (Open / In Progress / Completed / Cancelled). `complete: true` on the last two is what makes them count as closed.
_notes.record_configs: Both keys are set deliberately. Harvested live spaces carry `record_config_ids` AND `record_configs[{id}]`, and the frontend reads them differently — see microstrate/src/components/spaces/records/space-record-configs.utils.ts. Setting only one leaves the record tabs half-wired.
_notes.client: `Client` is the SHARED personal-contact record every account already has (financial_advisor's). It is REFERENCED here, never redefined — a record config with that id already exists and deployVerticals uses the create subject, which 409s. UWClient is this vertical's own commercial applicant record.
